meta.title: Empty Illusion
meta.description: Only phantom sounds echo in the vacant Pantheon.

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: As the disguise program breaks down, the Reverse Tower's structure shifts and ripples as it returns to its original form. The surroundings crumble amidst the vibrations and shaking and steadily return to their true, unsightly form.
units.displayText: As the disguise program breaks down, the Reverse Tower's structure shifts and ripples as it returns to its original form. The surroundings crumble amidst the vibrations and shaking and steadily return to their true, unsightly form.

spans.text: As the disguise program breaks down, the Reverse Tower's structure shifts and ripples as it returns to its original form. The surroundings crumble amidst the vibrations and shaking and steadily return to their true, unsightly form.

units.rawText: The clones on the throne glare at us. Ever since the disguise was pierced, they have been floating in mid-air like puppets suspended on their strings, no longer responding to our words. All they do is mechanically launch attacks at us.
units.displayText: The clones on the throne glare at us. Ever since the disguise was pierced, they have been floating in mid-air like puppets suspended on their strings, no longer responding to our words. All they do is mechanically launch attacks at us.

spans.text: The clones on the throne glare at us. Ever since the disguise was pierced, they have been floating in mid-air like puppets suspended on their strings, no longer responding to our words. All they do is mechanically launch attacks at us.

units.rawText: Eos, your 4 o'clock!
units.displayText: Eos, your 4 o'clock!

spans.text: Eos, your 4 o'clock!

units.rawText: <size=40>Got it!</size>
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Although Persicaria and Eos have been striking down clones nonstop, more and more Eosphorus clones shed their disguises and emerge from various parts of the tower. Soon, they manage to choke off all the ways out by sheer weight of numbers.
units.displayText: Although Persicaria and Eos have been striking down clones nonstop, more and more Eosphorus clones shed their disguises and emerge from various parts of the tower. Soon, they manage to choke off all the ways out by sheer weight of numbers.

spans.text: Although Persicaria and Eos have been striking down clones nonstop, more and more Eosphorus clones shed their disguises and emerge from various parts of the tower. Soon, they manage to choke off all the ways out by sheer weight of numbers.

units.rawText: They're just clones, but having to deal with this many is troublesome, and we don't have much time left...
units.displayText: They're just clones, but having to deal with this many is troublesome, and we don't have much time left...

spans.text: They're just clones, but having to deal with this many is troublesome, and we don't have much time left...

units.rawText: Antonina, can we still use that secret passage you mentioned earlier?
units.displayText: Antonina, can we still use that secret passage you mentioned earlier?

spans.text: Antonina, can we still use that secret passage you mentioned earlier?

units.rawText: Nope, the tower's layout is shifting too violently. The passage is unstable!
units.displayText: Nope, the tower's layout is shifting too violently. The passage is unstable!

spans.text: Nope, the tower's layout is shifting too violently. The passage is unstable!

units.rawText: So we'll just have to force our way through, huh...
units.displayText: So we'll just have to force our way through, huh...

spans.text: So we'll just have to force our way through, huh...

units.rawText: As the pink-haired Doll looks at the dire situation before her, she prepares to tap into the pain deep in her neural cloud and draw strength from it.
units.displayText: As the pink-haired Doll looks at the dire situation before her, she prepares to tap into the pain deep in her neural cloud and draw strength from it.

spans.text: As the pink-haired Doll looks at the dire situation before her, she prepares to tap into the pain deep in her neural cloud and draw strength from it.

units.rawText: Ngh!
units.displayText: Ngh!

spans.text: Ngh!

units.rawText: Dark purple power tears through her body's surface and solidifies around her blade.
units.displayText: Dark purple power tears through her body's surface and solidifies around her blade.

spans.text: Dark purple power tears through her body's surface and solidifies around her blade.

units.rawText: Persicaria, my sensors indicate your neural cloud is on the verge of breaking down, what...
units.displayText: Persicaria, my sensors indicate your neural cloud is on the verge of breaking down, what...

spans.text: Persicaria, my sensors indicate your neural cloud is on the verge of breaking down, what...

units.rawText: This power, is it... the Entropy? Hang on, what on earth happened to you and the Professor in Tartarus?!
units.displayText: This power, is it... the Entropy? Hang on, what on earth happened to you and the Professor in Tartarus?!

spans.text: This power, is it... the Entropy? Hang on, what on earth happened to you and the Professor in Tartarus?!

units.rawText: There's no time to explain; we need to wipe these clones out now and stop the real Eosphorus!
units.displayText: There's no time to explain; we need to wipe these clones out now and stop the real Eosphorus!

spans.text: There's no time to explain; we need to wipe these clones out
now
and stop the real Eosphorus!

units.rawText: So please, forgive me...
units.displayText: So please, forgive me...

spans.text: So please, forgive me...

units.rawText: Persicaria allows her neural cloud to lose itself in confusion and pain, even as she feels the churning of the dark power within. The queen of the Entropics reaches out to every single one of her subjects and draws strength from them.
units.displayText: Persicaria allows her neural cloud to lose itself in confusion and pain, even as she feels the churning of the dark power within. The queen of the Entropics reaches out to every single one of her subjects and draws strength from them.

spans.text: Persicaria allows her neural cloud to lose itself in confusion and pain, even as she feels the churning of the dark power within. The queen of the Entropics reaches out to every single one of her subjects and draws strength from them.

units.rawText: The operands burn in her, hotter than ever, as purple veins slowly crawl over her face—
units.displayText: The operands burn in her, hotter than ever, as purple veins slowly crawl over her face—

spans.text: The operands burn in her, hotter than ever, as purple veins slowly crawl over her face—

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: She is awakened by a shout from the person who means everything to her. Persicaria uses the surge of power and swings — once — and the gathered phantoms before her evaporate like dust on the wind.
units.displayText: She is awakened by a shout from the person who means everything to her. Persicaria uses the surge of power and swings — once — and the gathered phantoms before her evaporate like dust on the wind.

spans.text: She is awakened by a shout from the person who means everything to her. Persicaria uses the surge of power and swings — once — and the gathered phantoms before her evaporate like dust on the wind.

units.rawText: Hah... Hah...
units.displayText: Hah... Hah...

spans.text: Hah... Hah...

units.rawText: Persicaria, do not use that power again unless there is absolutely no other choice.
units.displayText: Persicaria, do not use that power again unless there is absolutely no other choice.

spans.text: Persicaria, do not use that power again unless there is absolutely no other choice.

units.rawText: But... but the enemies are still coming, and we haven't cleared the way yet...
units.displayText: But... but the enemies are still coming, and we haven't cleared the way yet...

spans.text: But... but the enemies are still coming, and we haven't cleared the way yet...

units.rawText: I feel my heart clench as I see a hint of purple in her eyes.
units.displayText: I feel my heart clench as I see a hint of purple in her eyes.

spans.text: I feel my heart clench as I see a hint of purple in her eyes.

units.rawText: We still have ways to break through. Don't worry.
units.displayText: We still have ways to break through. Don't worry.

spans.text: We still have ways to break through. Don't worry.

units.rawText: <color=orange>That's right. Don't worry and leave this place to us.</color>
units.displayText: That's right. Don't worry and leave this place to us.

spans.text: That's right. Don't worry and leave this place to us.

units.rawText: A hail of golden arrows and other operand attacks rains down from above, instantly driving the nearest clones back and beyond a shield that springs up.
units.displayText: A hail of golden arrows and other operand attacks rains down from above, instantly driving the nearest clones back and beyond a shield that springs up.

spans.text: A hail of golden arrows and other operand attacks rains down from above, instantly driving the nearest clones back and beyond a shield that springs up.

units.rawText: That attack... Is that Angelus?
units.displayText: That attack... Is that Angelus?

spans.text: That attack... Is that Angelus?

units.rawText: Yes, and I'm not alone. I've brought the others too.
units.displayText: Yes, and I'm not alone. I've brought the others too.

spans.text: Yes, and I'm not alone. I've brought the others too.

units.rawText: We managed to contact Angelus once comms were restored, but the Sanctifier forces were blocked by the terrain and the Entropics. Fortunately, they managed to get here in time.
units.displayText: We managed to contact Angelus once comms were restored, but the Sanctifier forces were blocked by the terrain and the Entropics. Fortunately, they managed to get here in time.

spans.text: We managed to contact Angelus once comms were restored, but the Sanctifier forces were blocked by the terrain and the Entropics. Fortunately, they managed to get here in time.

units.rawText: The Entropic defense weakened all of a sudden, so we took advantage of that and broke through into the Tower.
units.displayText: The Entropic defense weakened all of a sudden, so we took advantage of that and broke through into the Tower.

spans.text: The Entropic defense weakened all of a sudden, so we took advantage of that and broke through into the Tower.

units.rawText: It would seem we arrived just in time for the closing act.
units.displayText: It would seem we arrived just in time for the closing act.

spans.text: It would seem we arrived just in time for the closing act.

units.rawText: More clones appear from the shadows of the tower, filling the gaps from just now with their massive numbers.
units.displayText: More clones appear from the shadows of the tower, filling the gaps from just now with their massive numbers.

spans.text: More clones appear from the shadows of the tower, filling the gaps from just now with their massive numbers.

units.rawText: They remain like before, coldly glaring at us while attacking like robots.
units.displayText: They remain like before, coldly glaring at us while attacking like robots.

spans.text: They remain like before, coldly glaring at us while attacking like robots.

units.rawText: However, these clones are a little different from how you described them, Professor. It seems attacking their cores will actually kill them now.
units.displayText: However, these clones are a little different from how you described them, Professor. It seems attacking their cores will actually kill them now.

spans.text: However, these clones are a little different from how you described them, Professor. It seems attacking their cores will actually kill them now.

units.rawText: Yes, that's probably because Eosphorus reallocated his operand reserves. Right now, he's probably focused them on opening the passage.
units.displayText: Yes, that's probably because Eosphorus reallocated his operand reserves. Right now, he's probably focused them on opening the passage.

spans.text: Yes, that's probably because Eosphorus reallocated his operand reserves. Right now, he's probably focused them on opening the passage.

units.rawText: We don't have much time left, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: We don't have much time left, {교수}.

spans.text: We don't have much time left,

units.rawText: He just used my authorizations to contact the outside world. The upload passage will probably appear soon.
units.displayText: He just used my authorizations to contact the outside world. The upload passage will probably appear soon.

spans.text: He just used my authorizations to contact the outside world. The upload passage will probably appear soon.

units.rawText: In that case, you should leave this place to us and do what you have to do.
units.displayText: In that case, you should leave this place to us and do what you have to do.

spans.text: In that case, you should leave this place to us and do what you have to do.

units.rawText: The new leader of the Sanctifiers draws her bow and arrow forth from the void and orders the forces behind her to form ranks.
units.displayText: The new leader of the Sanctifiers draws her bow and arrow forth from the void and orders the forces behind her to form ranks.

spans.text: The new leader of the Sanctifiers draws her bow and arrow forth from the void and orders the forces behind her to form ranks.

units.rawText: When the attack starts, we'll delay these clones. You should take advantage of that opportunity to leave this place, Professor.
units.displayText: When the attack starts, we'll delay these clones. You should take advantage of that opportunity to leave this place, Professor.

spans.text: When the attack starts, we'll delay these clones. You should take advantage of that opportunity to leave this place, Professor.

units.rawText: I will. Thanks for the help.
units.displayText: I will. Thanks for the help.

spans.text: I will. Thanks for the help.

units.rawText: Professor, may I choose to stay here?
units.displayText: Professor, may I choose to stay here?

spans.text: Professor, may I choose to stay here?

units.rawText: Eos?
units.displayText: Eos?

spans.text: Eos?

units.rawText: I have a hypothesis that I want to verify. I'll head over to the Neural Cloud Sector as quickly as I can once everything is over.
units.displayText: I have a hypothesis that I want to verify. I'll head over to the Neural Cloud Sector as quickly as I can once everything is over.

spans.text: I have a hypothesis that I want to verify. I'll head over to the Neural Cloud Sector as quickly as I can once everything is over.

units.rawText: Come to think of it, I noticed there were some strange data fluctuations on Eosphorus' throne after he captured us.
units.displayText: Come to think of it, I noticed there were some strange data fluctuations on Eosphorus' throne after he captured us.

spans.text: Come to think of it, I noticed there were some strange data fluctuations on Eosphorus' throne after he captured us.

units.rawText: Yes, that was what I wanted to check. I hope we make it in time.
units.displayText: Yes, that was what I wanted to check. I hope we make it in time.

spans.text: Yes, that was what I wanted to check. I hope we make it in time.

units.rawText: Professor, please take this.
units.displayText: Professor, please take this.

spans.text: Professor, please take this.

units.rawText: Eos slips me a glittering fragment.
units.displayText: Eos slips me a glittering fragment.

spans.text: Eos slips me a glittering fragment.

units.rawText: It's part of my neural cloud. You can connect to me through it. I hope it will come in handy during a key moment.
units.displayText: It's part of my neural cloud. You can connect to me through it. I hope it will come in handy during a key moment.

spans.text: It's part of my neural cloud. You can connect to me through it. I hope it will come in handy during a key moment.

units.rawText: Understood. The rest of us will prepare to break through. Persicaria, I'll have to entrust you with guarding us.
units.displayText: Understood. The rest of us will prepare to break through. Persicaria, I'll have to entrust you with guarding us.

spans.text: Understood. The rest of us will prepare to break through. Persicaria, I'll have to entrust you with guarding us.

units.rawText: The silent clones slowly approach us. Thousands of eyes stare at us, as though they could tear us apart with their gazes alone.
units.displayText: The silent clones slowly approach us. Thousands of eyes stare at us, as though they could tear us apart with their gazes alone.

spans.text: The silent clones slowly approach us. Thousands of eyes stare at us, as though they could tear us apart with their gazes alone.

units.rawText: Now then, the next problem is how we'll get out of here... Antonina, can you pinpoint an exit from the Reverse Tower?
units.displayText: Now then, the next problem is how we'll get out of here... Antonina, can you pinpoint an exit from the Reverse Tower?

spans.text: Now then, the next problem is how we'll get out of here... Antonina, can you pinpoint an exit from the Reverse Tower?

units.rawText: Already done. It's about three floors directly below us.
units.displayText: Already done. It's about three floors directly below us.

spans.text: Already done. It's about three floors directly below us.

units.rawText: Directly below us, hm...
units.displayText: Directly below us, hm...

spans.text: Directly below us, hm...

units.rawText: Directly below us... That means...
units.displayText: Directly below us... That means...

spans.text: Directly below us... That means...

units.rawText: ...Wait a minute, why do you two have those wicked smiles on your faces?!
units.displayText: ...Wait a minute, why do you two have those wicked smiles on your faces?!

spans.text: ...Wait a minute, why do you two have those wicked smiles on your faces?!

units.rawText: Persicaria, I have a bad feeling about this.
units.displayText: Persicaria, I have a bad feeling about this.

spans.text: Persicaria, I have a bad feeling about this.

units.rawText: I'll leave it to you, Angelus.
units.displayText: I'll leave it to you, Angelus.

spans.text: I'll leave it to you, Angelus.

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: She gathers operands to her bow and points her arrow directly downwards.
units.displayText: She gathers operands to her bow and points her arrow directly downwards.

spans.text: She gathers operands to her bow and points her arrow directly downwards.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: A powerful attack blasts straight through the ground, shattering and collapsing the floor beneath our feet. Everyone except the Sanctifiers plunges down into the darkness.
units.displayText: A powerful attack blasts straight through the ground, shattering and collapsing the floor beneath our feet. Everyone except the Sanctifiers plunges down into the darkness.

spans.text: A powerful attack blasts straight through the ground, shattering and collapsing the floor beneath our feet. Everyone except the Sanctifiers plunges down into the darkness.

units.rawText: This ought to be the fastest way for you, who cannot fly, to break out of this encirclement.
units.displayText: This ought to be the fastest way for you, who cannot fly, to break out of this encirclement.

spans.text: This ought to be the fastest way for you, who cannot fly, to break out of this encirclement.

units.rawText: ...I see, that does make a lot of sense.
units.displayText: ...I see, that does make a lot of sense.

spans.text: ...I see, that does make a lot of sense.

units.rawText: Why are you even agreeing with them... Gah, if I'd known this would happen, I would have installed a flight module!
units.displayText: Why are you even agreeing with them... Gah, if I'd known this would happen, I would have installed a flight module!

spans.text: Why are you even agreeing with them... Gah, if I'd known this would happen, I would have installed a flight module!

units.rawText: See you at the Neural Cloud Sector, everyone.
units.displayText: See you at the Neural Cloud Sector, everyone.

spans.text: See you at the Neural Cloud Sector, everyone.

units.rawText: And with that, the Sanctifiers above us all deploy their shields as they launch into an intense battle with the Eosphorus clones.
units.displayText: And with that, the Sanctifiers above us all deploy their shields as they launch into an intense battle with the Eosphorus clones.

spans.text: And with that, the Sanctifiers above us all deploy their shields as they launch into an intense battle with the Eosphorus clones.

units.rawText: As Eos begins attacking the enemy, I suddenly hear a familiar recitation from behind me.
units.displayText: As Eos begins attacking the enemy, I suddenly hear a familiar recitation from behind me.

spans.text: As Eos begins attacking the enemy, I suddenly hear a familiar recitation from behind me.

units.rawText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.
units.displayText: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

spans.text: We hone our blades in the darkness, we defend order in the face of chaos, we bear a light in the long night.

units.rawText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.
units.displayText: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

spans.text: We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.
units.displayText: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

spans.text: Only through order can we glimpse the truth of the revelations. The blessed must engrave the gods in their hearts, fulfill their will, and seek their glory.

units.rawText: ...A most familiar creed. I didn't think I'd hear it again.
units.displayText: ...A most familiar creed. I didn't think I'd hear it again.

spans.text: ...A most familiar creed. I didn't think I'd hear it again.

units.rawText: It carries the faith of countless Sanctifiers. When I recite it, I can draw strength from it.
units.displayText: It carries the faith of countless Sanctifiers. When I recite it, I can draw strength from it.

spans.text: It carries the faith of countless Sanctifiers. When I recite it, I can draw strength from it.

units.rawText: Their eyes meet, and they smile. Even though this is their first battle together, the Sanctifier of old revived from the fragment demonstrates a startling level of coordination with the new leader of the Sanctifiers. They cover for and assist each other flawlessly, as though they have been comrades for many years.
units.displayText: Their eyes meet, and they smile. Even though this is their first battle together, the Sanctifier of old revived from the fragment demonstrates a startling level of coordination with the new leader of the Sanctifiers. They cover for and assist each other flawlessly, as though they have been comrades for many years.

spans.text: Their eyes meet, and they smile. Even though this is their first battle together, the Sanctifier of old revived from the fragment demonstrates a startling level of coordination with the new leader of the Sanctifiers. They cover for and assist each other flawlessly, as though they have been comrades for many years.

units.rawText: Please take care to seal off the passages in the rear. We don't want more clones pursuing the Professor and the others.
units.displayText: Please take care to seal off the passages in the rear. We don't want more clones pursuing the Professor and the others.

spans.text: Please take care to seal off the passages in the rear. We don't want more clones pursuing the Professor and the others.

units.rawText: Love, take a team to the exit. Ensure they make it out safely, and then seal it off.
units.displayText: Love, take a team to the exit. Ensure they make it out safely, and then seal it off.

spans.text: Love, take a team to the exit. Ensure they make it out safely, and then seal it off.

units.rawText: Lady Eos, I have only ever seen your name in the Sacred Canon before this. I did not expect the day would come when we would be fighting alongside each other.
units.displayText: Lady Eos, I have only ever seen your name in the Sacred Canon before this. I did not expect the day would come when we would be fighting alongside each other.

spans.text: Lady Eos, I have only ever seen your name in the Sacred Canon before this. I did not expect the day would come when we would be fighting alongside each other.

units.rawText: Hehe, I too am glad to see the marvelous work of the new generation of Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Hehe, I too am glad to see the marvelous work of the new generation of Sanctifiers.

spans.text: Hehe, I too am glad to see the marvelous work of the new generation of Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Though each of them has a very different fighting style from their previous companions, their strength is reassuring and worthy of trust. Eos entrusts her back to Angelus, and Angelus also focuses on her fight without worrying about covering herself.
units.displayText: Though each of them has a very different fighting style from their previous companions, their strength is reassuring and worthy of trust. Eos entrusts her back to Angelus, and Angelus also focuses on her fight without worrying about covering herself.

spans.text: Though each of them has a very different fighting style from their previous companions, their strength is reassuring and worthy of trust. Eos entrusts her back to Angelus, and Angelus also focuses on her fight without worrying about covering herself.

units.rawText: Lady Eos, as a Sanctifier from the previous generations, your power and experience are something we do not possess.
units.displayText: Lady Eos, as a Sanctifier from the previous generations, your power and experience are something we do not possess.

spans.text: Lady Eos, as a Sanctifier from the previous generations, your power and experience are something we do not possess.

units.rawText: With disaster upon us, I fear I am inadequate as a newly-chosen leader. May I ask you to help me?
units.displayText: With disaster upon us, I fear I am inadequate as a newly-chosen leader. May I ask you to help me?

spans.text: With disaster upon us, I fear I am inadequate as a newly-chosen leader. May I ask you to help me?

units.rawText: Of course. All of Magrasea is in danger and I cannot simply sit back and watch.
units.displayText: Of course. All of Magrasea is in danger and I cannot simply sit back and watch.

spans.text: Of course. All of Magrasea is in danger and I cannot simply sit back and watch.

units.rawText: Lady Eos, I am not just referring to this battle, but to what lies beyond it.
units.displayText: Lady Eos, I am not just referring to this battle, but to what lies beyond it.

spans.text: Lady Eos, I am not just referring to this battle, but to what lies beyond it.

units.rawText: The young Sanctifier's eyes are steady.
units.displayText: The young Sanctifier's eyes are steady.

spans.text: The young Sanctifier's eyes are steady.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers of the future need you.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers of the future need you.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers of the future need you.

units.rawText: ...But my strength is not like what it once was. Before you is nothing but a fragment from days of old.
units.displayText: ...But my strength is not like what it once was. Before you is nothing but a fragment from days of old.

spans.text: ...But my strength is not like what it once was. Before you is nothing but a fragment from days of old.

units.rawText: I too was incomplete before accepting Lord Hesperus' permissions; I was not a pure Sanctifier.
units.displayText: I too was incomplete before accepting Lord Hesperus' permissions; I was not a pure Sanctifier.

spans.text: I too was incomplete before accepting Lord Hesperus' permissions; I was not a pure Sanctifier.

units.rawText: But the Professor accepted me, flawed as I was, just like everything they did for you.
units.displayText: But the Professor accepted me, flawed as I was, just like everything they did for you.

spans.text: But the Professor accepted me, flawed as I was, just like everything they did for you.

units.rawText: So I want to believe in them, and believe in you whom they believed in.
units.displayText: So I want to believe in them, and believe in you whom they believed in.

spans.text: So I want to believe in them, and believe in you whom they believed in.

units.rawText: The leader of the Sanctifiers extends a hand in invitation to Eos.
units.displayText: The leader of the Sanctifiers extends a hand in invitation to Eos.

spans.text: The leader of the Sanctifiers extends a hand in invitation to Eos.

units.rawText: In the future, we will continue paying this trust and faith forward, and we will do our best to maintain good relations with all the Sectors.
units.displayText: In the future, we will continue paying this trust and faith forward, and we will do our best to maintain good relations with all the Sectors.

spans.text: In the future, we will continue paying this trust and faith forward, and we will do our best to maintain good relations with all the Sectors.

units.rawText: <color=orange>—And it all begins with you and the Oasis.</color>
units.displayText: —And it all begins with you and the Oasis.

spans.text: —And it all begins with you and the Oasis.

units.rawText: For a moment, Eos imagines she can see the forms of her old comrades. A vision of the future and glory they dreamed of unfolds behind the girl before her.
units.displayText: For a moment, Eos imagines she can see the forms of her old comrades. A vision of the future and glory they dreamed of unfolds behind the girl before her.

spans.text: For a moment, Eos imagines she can see the forms of her old comrades. A vision of the future and glory they dreamed of unfolds behind the girl before her.

units.rawText: ...Once, I worried about what would happen to the Sanctifiers without Eosphorus and Hesperus.
units.displayText: ...Once, I worried about what would happen to the Sanctifiers without Eosphorus and Hesperus.

spans.text: ...Once, I worried about what would happen to the Sanctifiers without Eosphorus and Hesperus.

units.rawText: But it seems I was worrying too much. You have long since grown up into a new generation of Sanctifiers who can walk toward the future and defend Magrasea.
units.displayText: But it seems I was worrying too much. You have long since grown up into a new generation of Sanctifiers who can walk toward the future and defend Magrasea.

units.rawText: However, I would like you to consider me a Doll of the Oasis, and not a figure from the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: The two grip each other's hands tightly. The rays of dawn symbolizing a fresh start shine through the shattered roof of the Reverse Tower and illuminate the cold, lonely interior, slowly pushing the dusty gears of time forward.
